svg.text: ETHOnline 2026 · Continuity Track — The Graph (AI Use Case) + Circle Arc (Treasury) + World (Selfie Check)
Hosted on Vercel · passkey login + World ID / paid access gates
Hosted on Render · SSE streaming · single long-lived server (not serverless)
Judge overrides rule-based verdict only on a real
specialist answer — verified on a 4-contract ground-truth set
separate treasury wallet, keyed by ref_id on the passkey address
USDC is Arc's native asset, not an ERC-20
→ ARC (mainnet) — config switch, no code change
wallet address is never trusted by itself; nonce signature proves control
Auth · entitlements · World ID · scan history · ledger
3 World ID scans or paid credits; atomic reserve/refund per analysis
all authoritative access/account state survives backend restarts
returning users recover real history, credits and account activity
Firestore + Circle are sources of truth; frontend state
cannot mint credits or bypass /analyze authorization
Track qualification: live, load-bearing use of The Graph (reasoning over real evidence, not a raw query dump)
plus real Arc Testnet balances and a confirmed $5 USDC → 10-scan payment flow in a live multi-chain product.
World ID Selfie Check: free-trial Sybil defense, keyed on nullifier not wallet — see README §10.3
Mainnet launch is a small bootstrap (personal funds and/or hackathon prize winnings), not a dependency on a large external raise — see README §10.5.
